L1 ACCEPT · head `e116b15bf7c35b65ccc3dc578643a899f5031d67` · 2026-11-22T11:16Z

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:无,这是车队内部规则。新增你在决策卡上选「五条都写」的五条:协调者开卡线程前,先查派单的档位那一行有没有出处;卡线程开工第一步,核对实际拿到的档位并报给席位;协调者会话、区线程、总监席的档位或 effort 补齐取值。另外写进你上午答复的两件事:只申报契约变更的卡,L2 用默认档;`dispatch-gates.mjs` 印出的那句旧档位话改成与规则一致。
- 为什么做:卡 #36358 的第二个、也是最后一个 PR(第 11–15 项,加上裁决 7077400471,以及上一个 PR 审核留下的三处 nit)。
- 出错会怎样:最多是席位或协调者误退一张派单,或者线程多报一次档位,耽误几分钟;不影响产品和用户数据,可以撤回。
- 要你做什么:批准合并(`Rule-change: yes`,Tier H)。
- 席位意见:L1 ACCEPT;另有一处可选的精简,见下面,不改判。

## 席位核对

- 形态:`l1-face --pr 36413` CLEAN,13 项都是 ok。draft、base `main`、`Fixes #36358`:第一个 PR #36376 已合并,本 PR 交付余下的第 11–15 项和卡上 PR 2 的验收,所以合并后关卡是对的。7 个文件 +17 −11;无已发布包(`skip-changeset`);`Clause-②: no`、`Metadata-protocol: none` 属实。`Rule-change: yes` 正确:这五条是 Q13 批准的新规则,不是照录已有裁决,所以要维护者批合。
- 逐项对卡:
  - 第 11 项:`coordinator.md` 四新增一句。`model:` 写了上限,而同一行既没有 `--tier` MANDATORY,也没有点名裁决的 `reason:`(评论 id,或常设档位令的 id 和时刻),就退回席位,不开线程。卡上 PR 2 的验收例句 `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER (reason: spec contract surface; Clause-② yes)` 的 `reason:` 没有点名裁决,按这句会被退回,验收满足。
  - 第 12 项:`os-dev.md` 新增卡线程首步:读实供档并对派发令,高或低都在开工前报席位,首报带实供档。`dispatch-runbook.md` 卡线程节新增:席位把它写进认领的 Container & model 行,不符时席位定夺前不开工。两半合起来就是卡上的原句。
  - 第 13、14、15 项:都写进定档节,分别是协调者会话默认判断档、effort `high`;区线程独立成行,默认判断档、effort `high`,MANDATORY 卡起隔离契约审核档子代理或另开卡线程;总监席加 effort `high`,档位仍由维护者按项目定。原来卡线程那一行里的「区线程 effort `high`」挪到了区线程自己的行,没有丢。
- 裁决 7077400471:
  - 第 2 条:`dispatch-gates.mjs:13273` 只改一句印出的话,没有动判断逻辑、推导行或常量,`dispatch-gates.data.mjs` 没有碰。新句子「a ceiling build takes a path-derived mandate or the maintainer's explicit order」与定档节第一行一致。保留了 self-test 用来定位这一行的「The tier stays」和结尾的 `ceiling …)`,也避开了 no-mandate 渲染里不许出现的大写词;`pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` 2252 条都过。
  - 第 1 条:见下面那一点。
- N8–N10(SKILL.md〈升级与决策〉):N8,「呈裁只经总监席与决策线程(简单问题除外)」把例外挪到了路线后面,不再读成在修饰「恒由维护者人工裁」。N9,「需人工裁(简单问题除外)先过决策线程」补上了例外。N10,「席位与分诊的简单问题可免卡直问」,dev 不在其列,与 `os-dev.md:357`「需维护者裁的事 dev ⛔ 不直接问他」一致。Q14 原话没说谁可以直接问,正文已写明这是较窄的读法,请维护者在批合时确认。
- 字节:五个文件的棘轮行都等于 head 上的实际字节数(SKILL.md 33919、dispatch-runbook.md 20483、coordinator.md 4427、execution-duties.md 22494、os-dev.md 38986,我用 `wc -c` 逐个核过)。每行注释都引了裁决 id 和原话;行内没有卡号、评论 id 或带日期的引语。os-dev.md 实际多了 140 字节,上限只升了 138,差的 2 字节是原来上限比文件大出的余量,正文说的「升幅等于新文本字节数」在这一行差这 2 字节,不影响什么。
- 一处可选的精简(不改判,留给席位和维护者):定档节第 159 行新增「只申报契约变更(`Clause-②: yes`)而 diff 不碰已发布 spec 文件与车队规则文本的卡,L2 审核不取契约审核档,档照 `contract-review.md` 申报行」。紧挨着的上一行刚说过「审核档 … 只住 `contract-review.md`」,而 `contract-review.md:11`「仅凭 `Clause-②: yes` 申报而欠 ⇒ `TIER_DEFAULT`」已经是同一条规则,正文也写了「That file already says so」。所以这一行等于在审核档的出处之外又写了一遍,和本卡「避免散落在各处」的目的有点相反。裁决 7077400471 第 1 条是「同意席位的建议」,当时席位预计不必改文字。可以删掉这一行(execution-duties.md 的上限随之降下来),也可以保留作为指针;两种都不违反清单。
- 证据:没有改测试文件;self-test 电池的读数在正文里;第一次推的措辞挂了一条,第二个提交改掉了。本地门禁 69 条在 fd54f8fb4 上跑过,两条失败的在 e116b15bf 上重跑,两个 head 只差一个字符串。我没有在本地重跑,读的是报告和 CI。
- CI @ `e116b15b`:26 success · 22 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending;mergeable_state clean。
- 落地条款:Tier H(`Rule-change: yes`,改了 `SKILL.md`、`os-dev.md` 和 `dispatch-gates.mjs`)。席位的 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER L2 PASS 后,由席位交维护者批合;合并后卡自动关闭。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e116b15bf7c35b65ccc3dc578643a899f5031d67`
Local-runs: probe — one `git merge-tree` of the head against `origin/main` at `ff6014990`, because main moved `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` and its self-test after the PR's base and the one-sentence change had to be shown to merge clean; nothing built, tested or re-run
Scope: .claude/agents/os-dev.md,.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md,.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/coordinator.md,.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md,.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md,scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs,scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs + none
Rule-change-verified: yes

Review of PR #36413 (Fixes #36358, the card's second pull request). Read: the card body and its nine comments (ruling record 7076315104, addendum 7076338827, ruling record 7077400471, both claims, the three dev reports, the triage note); the PR body; the net diff against main (seven files, 17 insertions, 11 deletions, two commits on base `124c934da`); the check-runs on this head (no failure, no pending; the rest are success or expected skips). The delta record of PR #36376 was read for N8 to N10. The seven changed files are all `hits`; no other file is in the diff, so the scope adds none.

Rule-change: the PR body declares `Rule-change: yes` and carries no `Ruling-ref:` line. That is right. Five hunks change what gets done and in what order (the coordinator returns an order, a thread checks its served tier, three role rows gain values), and one line of the frozen instrument changes. The card and ruling 7077400471 item 2 both say this pull request lands Tier H by the maintainer's approval. `ruled` is not claimed and is not available.

### ① Derived judgments

- No accept-set change and no public-surface change: right. The diff is five rule files, five rows of one data map and one string literal.
- The `dispatch-gates.mjs` change is text only: right. One template literal inside the `!mandatory` branch of `tierLines` (line 13273). The three interpolations `TIER_FLOOR`, `TIER_DEFAULT` and `TIER_CEILING` are unchanged and in the same order. No condition, constant, glob row or derivation line moved. `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` and `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` are not in the diff.
- The self-test still finds the line: right. It selects the line by `includes('The tier stays')` (self-test line 11091 at the head) and then requires `ceiling X)` with the derived family word. The new sentence starts "The tier stays below the ceiling" and ends "ceiling ${TIER_CEILING})." It also names the floor and the default, and it does not hold the upper-case word the no-mandate case refuses. The check-run "Lint · PM dispatch-gates" is success on this head.
- The freeze is opened by a ruling: right. The card and ruling 7076315104 point 3 forbid any edit to this file. Ruling 7077400471 item 2 is the maintainer's explicit permission for this sentence alone, and amended claim 7077620306 opens the file surface for it.
- Main moved the same file after the base (three hunks near lines 468, 8713 and 9992, far from 13273). The merge is clean.
- The five ratchet rows rise by exactly the new bytes: right. Measured at base and head: `coordinator.md` 4230 to 4427 (+197), `dispatch-runbook.md` 20344 to 20483 (+139), `execution-duties.md` 22158 to 22494 (+336), `SKILL.md` 33881 to 33919 (+38), `os-dev.md` 38846 to 38986 (+140 bytes of text; the row moves 38848 to 38986, +138, because 2 bytes were headroom). Every new row equals its file's size at the head. Each row comment names a ruling id: 7076315104 (Q13) on four rows, 7077400471 item 1 on the home's row, 7076338827 on `SKILL.md`. No line of the script outside those five rows changed.
- The mandated set (Q8) is untouched: right. Home lines 146 to 155 are unchanged; no glob row changed.

### ② Semver level

Nothing publishes. The PR carries the `skip-changeset` label and no changeset, which is right for rule text, one data table and one printed sentence. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body are right: no published schema, export or authorable key is touched.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report 7078266026:

- Deviation 1 (the first head was red on one self-test case; the second commit rewords the sentence): accepted. The reviewed head is the second one and its check-run is green.
- Deviation 2 (69 local commands at the first head, two re-run at the final head): accepted. The two heads differ by one string literal, and the check-runs on this head are the gate verdicts read here.
- Deviation 3 (N10 keeps the dev rule strict): accepted, judged in ④.
- Deviation 4 (no text change in `contract-review.md` for ruling 7077400471 item 1): accepted. Its line 9 to 11 already says a card owed only by the `Clause-②: yes` declaration is reviewed at `TIER_DEFAULT`. See S1 for the wording of the home's pointer line.
- `open_questions`: none. Out-of-scope findings (line 11 of `contract-review.md` against Q1; the `readContainerModelLine` docblock): already with the seat, outside the amended surface, not reviewed here.
- SQL push-down: no query code in the diff.

### ④ Design judgment

`references/coordinator.md` (item 11). The new line in section 四 holds against the card's wording clause by clause: before a card thread opens; `model:` names the ceiling; neither a `--tier` MANDATORY line nor a `reason:` that names a ruling (a comment id, or a standing tier order's id and time); back to the seat; no thread. The acceptance order `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER (reason: spec contract surface; Clause-② yes)` is returned by it, because that reason names no ruling. The line agrees with home line 157, which asks for the same two citations on the same line. It states no tier value of its own.

`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` and `references/dispatch-runbook.md` (item 12). The thread's first step reads the served tier and compares it with the order; a mismatch either way is reported before work; the first report carries the served tier; the seat writes it into the claim's `Container & model` line. All four parts of the card's item are present. `readings-session.md` lines 16 to 20 do say how the served tier is read (`get_session`, `last_served_model`, and the transcript fallback), so the pointer resolves. The runbook names `os-dev.md` as the home of the check, so the step is stated once.

`references/execution-duties.md` (items 13 to 15, and ruling 7077400471 item 1). Coordinator session: default tier, effort `high`. Area thread: default tier, effort `high`, a MANDATORY card built by an isolated ceiling sub-agent or its own card thread. Director seat: tier still the maintainer's per-project choice, effort `high`. Each matches the card and the consequence line of Q13 (「协调者和区线程用 Opus 加 high、总监 effort 用 high」). The area-thread value left the card-thread line and has its own line, so no value is stated twice. No line names a model, a card number, a comment id or a dated quotation. No other file states a value for these three roles.

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (N8 to N10). N8: the exception now follows the route on line 284, so 「恒由维护者人工裁」 is no longer qualified by it. N9: line 279 carries the same exception as lines 277 and 284. N10: line 280 keeps the prohibition for seats, triage and dev, and names seats and triage only for the direct simple question. That matches the rulings. Q14 and addendum 7076338827 say a simple question may go to the maintainer in chat after the at-tier analysis; they do not name the dev, and no ruling on the card gives a dev a direct question. `os-dev.md` line 357, the file a dev reads, has said throughout that a dev reports `needs_decision` and never asks him directly. The narrower reading removes the one conflict between the two files and grants nothing new. The PR body puts the reading in front of the maintainer, who approves this pull request.

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`. The new sentence agrees with ruling 7077400471 item 2 ("the ceiling only on a mandatory line or the maintainer's explicit order") and with home lines 146, 147 and 156: with no mandate the PM picks floor or default, and a ceiling build needs a path-derived mandate or the maintainer's explicit order. No other file at the head quotes the old sentence.

`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`. Judged in ①: five rows, exact bytes, a ruling id on each.

Tried to break it: an order with a `reason:` that names no ruling (returned); a thread served above its order (reported, 「高或低」); a mandated card reaching an area thread (line 165 gives the two routes); a second statement of a role value outside the home (none found); a logic change hidden in the instrument hunk (none); a ratchet row raised above its file (none).

S1 (should-fix) — `references/execution-duties.md` line 159 draws its case with 「车队规则文本」, a term no file defines. The file it points at, `contract-review.md` lines 6 and 9, keys the ceiling review on 「governed 规则文本」, and `SKILL.md` line 192 defines that face widely (`docs/adr/**`, all of `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, `AGENTS.md`, the workflows). In the home's own vocabulary the nearest term is 车队规则面 on line 150, glossed as 「车队自己的规则文本与对外发布的技能」 and limited to four surfaces. Read that way, a card that declares `Clause-②: yes` and also edits an ADR or a `references/**` file is told its L2 does not take the ceiling, while `contract-review.md` says it does. The mechanical face reading still gives the right tier, but this card exists because a prose term was read against the tool. Use `contract-review.md`'s own term (「governed 规则文本」) on line 159 and move the row by the measured bytes. The ruling's meaning does not change: it says the ceiling stays owed when the diff edits a published spec file or fleet rule text.

Nits:

- N1 (nit): `dispatch-runbook.md` line 133 ends 「与令不符 ⇒ 席位定夺前不开工」. The card's item 12 says the mismatch is reported before any work; it does not say the thread waits for the seat's decision. The clause is the natural reading, the PR body states it, and the maintainer approves this pull request. Left as an accepted deviation.
- N2 (nit): the `SKILL.md` row comment says the +38 bytes are raised by ruling record 7076338827 and "named for seats and triage only". The ruling's words do not say who asks; the naming is the dev's reading, as the PR body says. The comment could say "read as" for that half. Left as an accepted deviation or folded into the S1 fix, which already touches this script.

Delta review of PR #36413 (Fixes #36358, the card's second pull request). The previous record is 7078357171: PASS at `e116b15bf7c35b65ccc3dc578643a899f5031d67` with S1 open. Read this round: the delta `e116b15bf..36cce5462` (one commit, two files, 2 insertions, 3 deletions); the PR body as it now stands; the second dev report 7078590039 on the card; the card's comment list (no ruling and no new order after 7077620306); the check-runs on this head (26 success, 22 skipped, no failure, no pending). The net diff against main is still the same seven files, all `hits`, so the scope adds none. Everything the previous record judged outside the two delta files is byte-identical and stands.

Rule-change: the PR body still declares `Rule-change: yes` with no `Ruling-ref:` line. That is still right. The delta removes one rule line and edits two row comments; the five hunks that change what gets done and in what order are untouched. The pull request waits for the maintainer.

S1: closed

### ① Derived judgments

- No accept-set change and no public-surface change: right. The delta is one deleted line of rule text and two rows of one data map.
- The `execution-duties.md` row is lowered by exactly the removed bytes: right. The deleted line is 178 bytes with its newline. The file is 22494 bytes at the previous head and 22316 at this head. The row moves 22494 to 22316, and 22316 equals the file size at the head. Against main (22158) the row is now +158, the bytes of items 13 to 15 alone.
- The row comment follows the bytes: right. It now reads "raised 22158 → 22316 (+158) by ruling record 7076315104 (Q13)" and no longer cites ruling 7077400471 item 1. That is correct, since that item no longer adds any byte to the file.
- The `SKILL.md` row is unchanged in value: right. Only its comment changed. The file is 33919 bytes at the head and the row is 33919.
- No other line of `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` changed. No logic, no other row.
- The check-run verdicts on this head are the gate verdicts. None failed.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged. Nothing publishes. The `skip-changeset` label is on the PR and there is no changeset, which is right for rule text and one data table. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body are right.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report 7078590039:

- Deviation 1 (41 commands re-run locally at this head, 30 of the 71 not re-run after the first head): accepted. The delta is one deleted prose line and two data rows, and the check-runs on this head are the gate verdicts read here.
- Deviation 2 (N10 stays a reading, now said in the row comment too): accepted. See N2 below.
- Deviation 3 (N1 left as accepted): accepted, as the previous record left it.
- Deviation 4 (S1 fixed by removal, not by the reword S1 proposed): accepted. Judged in ④; removal closes the finding fully.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

`references/execution-duties.md`. The line that used the undefined term 「车队规则文本」 is gone. No file under `.claude/` or `scripts/` at the head uses that term any more. The rule the line restated still holds in the tree without it. Line 158 of the home says the L2 review tier follows the face and lives only in `contract-review.md`. `contract-review.md` lines 9 to 11 say a review owed only by the `Clause-②: yes` declaration is at `TIER_DEFAULT`, and that a published schema or governed rule text takes `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. Home line 148 says the three contract signals never set the build tier. So ruling 7077400471 item 1 (「1 同意」) is carried by text that was already there, as the ruling expected, and the tier is now stated in one file only. Removal is a stronger fix than the reword: there is no second wording left that could drift from `contract-review.md`.
